dos.text: Set labelPosition="outside" when you want the whole row, not just the image, to be clickable via a real label element.
Listen for the real input/change events for selection handling, the item isn't backed by a native input and manually dispatches both on selection.

donts.text: Don't set title expecting a normal HTML tooltip, it's mapped onto the inner shadow-DOM item and removed from the host element itself.

Don't manage itemTabIndex yourself, it's a roving-tabindex pattern the parent moz-visual-picker controls so only one item is ever focusable at a time; setting it manually will fight the parent's own management.
